# `start_motion_monitor`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Start the motion monitor: watch the scene for movers, then track or capture (firmware 9.75, 64-bit only).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / READ |
| Side-effect tier | D |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.75, handler @0xf0010 (64-bit build) |

New in firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0, 64-bit build only (the 32-bit build has no such method). Runs a worker that detects motion, then either tracks the object or captures, then optionally returns the mount to its origin. Requires scenery view mode (view mode 1). All members are optional and omitted members keep their persisted values; the settings are saved. The detection area follows from sensitivity and is not client-settable. Progress is reported by the MotionMonitor event.

Side effects: Saves the motion-monitor settings, stops any object track (remembering its state), and starts a worker thread that drives detection, tracking or capture and mount return.

| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |

| `params.mode` | string | no | - | auto_track (0) or auto_capture (1). Other string 209, other type 105. One of: `auto_track`, `auto_capture`. [READ] |
| `params.sensitivity` | string | no | - | low (0), middle (1) or high (2). Other string 209, other type 105. One of: `low`, `middle`, `high`. [READ] |
| `params.return_to_origin` | boolean | no | - | Return the mount to its start position afterwards. Wrong type 106. [READ] |
| `params.waiting_time` | integer | no | - | Waiting time setting (unit unresolved). Wrong type 104. [READ; unit unresolved] |
| `params.duration_min` | integer | no | - | Run length in minutes: -1 for unlimited, otherwise 1 to 35791394. Out of range 209, wrong type 104. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 107 | params is not an object | `expected object` |
| 209 | a member value is out of range | `invalid argument` |
| 105 | mode or sensitivity is not a string | `expected string` |
| 106 | return_to_origin is not a bool | `expected bool` |
| 104 | waiting_time or duration_min is not an integer (meaning INFERRED) | `expected int` |
| 524 | smart follow, mount, AVI record, motion detection or object track conflicts | `busy` |
| 300 | RTSP not running, or the second-camera query got no valid answer | `not ready` |
| 268 | already running | `already running` |
| 210 | view mode is not scenery mode | `wrong mode` |
| 254 | stopping the track failed or the alt/az origin could not be read | `track stop failed` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Exact precondition order is in the handler and is not tabulated. Whether the whole call relays by target camera is INFERRED.

## Example

Request, request - READ shape, not captured; values invented:

```json
{"id":84,"method":"start_motion_monitor","params":{"mode":"auto_track","sensitivity":"middle","return_to_origin":true,"duration_min":-1}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"start_motion_monitor","result":0,"code":0,"id":84}
```
